name: Christopher Lee
bio: A Representative from New York; born in Kenmore, Erie County, N.Y., April 1, 1964; B.A., University of Rochester, Rochester, N.Y., 1987; M.B.A., Chapman University, Orange, Calif., 1997; businessman; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eleventh and to the succeeding Congress until his resignation on February 9, 2011 (January 3, 2009-February 9, 2011).
